stops.name: Reykhólar

stops.name: Hvammsfjörður
stops.detail: If weather conditions permit, you can also drive by car along the coast in the east of Snæfellsnes northwards along Hvammsfjörður (dt. Muldenfjord), the narrowest end of the fjord, and into the region of the Westfjords, which borders the fjord to the north.
